node.title: Parse for a name after a keyword search in all the files, given directory as input
node.author: prash_sri
node.doctext:
#!/usr/local/bin/perl $dir = $ARGV[0]; open(HANDLE,$dir) || die "ERROR in opening file"; @allfiles = readdir HANDLE; close(HANDLE); foreach $files (@allfiles) { open(FH,"<",$files)|| die "ERROR in opening file"; foreach $line () { $line =~ m/ \^module\ /g ; @next = split(/\s+/,$line); } close(FH); } print "$next[0]\n"

Trying to write a perl code which browses all the files recursively under a given input directory and do the following: - Parse all the list of module names. - Parse all the instance names inside each of the modules. Kindly let me know where am I going wrong!! And guide me for obtaining the correct output. Thanks
